title: SSTRE-Engine upstream lock
description: Pins the upstream engine repositories that SSTRE-Engine patch series apply to (ADR-0008). Upstream content is fetched from its original host; SSTRE publishes only its own patches.
$comment: Status: accepted with ADR-0008 (provisional), 2026-11-27. Owner: SSTRE-Engine. 2026-11-27 (POC-27): role 'dependency' and tag_hint added (backward compatible, schema_version unchanged).

name.description: Short identifier; also the patch directory name under patches/.

role.description: primary = engine baseline (ADR-0005); secondary = source of functionality to port, not built as the product; dependency = third-party library built into an engine variant (e.g. RayTracedGL1 for the RT backend).

branch_hint.description: Upstream branch the commit was taken from (informational; the commit is authoritative).

tag_hint.description: Upstream tag that points at the commit (informational; the commit is authoritative).

license.description: SPDX expression of the upstream as audited (RD-007).

swhid.description: Software Heritage identifier of the pinned revision, if archived.

patch_series.description: Directory (relative to the SSTRE-Engine root) holding NNNN-*.patch files applied in order with git am.

audit.description: Reference to the publication audit covering this pin.
